# Spot the Difference Game

## How to Play
Find all differences between the two images before time runs out! Click on spots where the images differ. Each level has 5-7 differences to discover. Use hints if you get stuck, but watch your time carefully!

🕹️ Click or tap to mark differences  
⏱️ 90 seconds per level  
🎯 5-7 differences per level  
🌟 Earn stars based on speed and accuracy
